distinctive_falsification_test: Require comparable deployed-task capability/cost, actual paid adoption and retained vendor economics. Falling feature prices, task failures, copying or customer capture can invalidate growth-to-value transfer.
competence_limits: Hardware/software compatibility, competing accelerators and export permissions require technical and regulatory evidence; management platform claims are not independent moat proof.
No recovered complete personal investment algorithm.
No immutable first-upload proof for every currently served source version.
No native position sizing, discount rate, universal buy/sell threshold or calibrated probability.
Team attribution only: no personal Cathie authorship established. ARK/Cathie are one family.
Big Ideas exact historical bytes and first-upload timing are unproven. Only accepted qualitative anchors are allowed; no forecast quantities, weights, source matrix or page 9.
ARK-X06 has lower temporal certainty and is not selected in these routes.
missing_evidence: Quality-adjusted capability and total deployed cost on comparable dated tasks
Paid adoption, customer savings, retention/pricing and company-specific capture
Actual data rights/competitive alternatives and cash/funding/dilution bridge
conditional_behavior: Preserve the assigned name, scope and gap. Return partial/abstention for essential missing evidence; never substitute a persona or fabricate numeric precision.
authorship_boundary: No target price, stock view, portfolio decision, current holding, native score, probability or weight is produced. Independent valuation requires its own evidence and review.
transport_boundary: Assigned lens and selected rule IDs only; no competing candidates, sibling view content/conclusions, route matrices, entire method module, current dossier, holding, case result or outcome. Design fact IDs are placeholders and not final source-fact bindings. No opinion execution permitted until external acceptance and all remaining gates pass.
